title: CBSE CTET September 2026 Correction / Edit Form
vacancyDetails: Eligibility test for Paper I (Classes I-V) and Paper II (Classes VI-VIII); no recruitment vacancy count is applicable.
qualification: Paper I: Senior Secondary with the required marks plus a qualifying Elementary Education / B.El.Ed / Special Education diploma. Paper II: Graduation or Post-Graduation with the required marks plus D.El.Ed / B.Ed / B.El.Ed / B.A.-B.Sc.Ed or another qualification listed in the official eligibility code.
ageLimit: No age limit is specified for appearing in CTET. Verify the latest official information bulletin and certificate eligibility rules.
applicationFee: Paper I: General / OBC ₹1,000; SC / ST / PWD ₹500. Both papers: General / OBC ₹1,200; SC / ST / PWD ₹600. Payment modes: Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Card / Mobile Wallet.
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, identity proof, address details, educational certificates and category / disability certificate where applicable.
howToApply:
1. Visit the official CTET application portal
2. Read the September 2026 information bulletin and select Paper I, Paper II or both
3. Complete registration and enter personal, academic and category details
4. Upload the photograph, signature and required documents
5. Pay the examination fee through the available official payment mode
6. Review every field, submit the form and save the confirmation page
7. Use the official portal for correction, admit card, answer key and result updates
shortDescription: CBSE CTET September 2026 is the central teacher eligibility examination for candidates targeting Paper I (Classes I-V), Paper II (Classes VI-VIII), or both papers. The correction window is active for eligible applicants.
content:
CBSE CTET September 2026 Correction / Edit Form is the correction window for eligible CTET applicants. The notice confirms the official CTET September 2026 information and the application re-opening dates.

CTET September 2026 Correction Form – Last Date Today

CBSE has released the correction notice for the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) September examination 2026 on the official website.

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start Date: 11 May 2026
  • Online Apply Last Date: 10 June 2026
  • Last Date for Fee Payment: 10 June 2026
  • Re-open Online Apply Start Date: 25 August 2026
  • Re-open Online Apply Last Date: 01 September 2026
  • Last Date for Fee Payment: 01 September 2026
  • Correction Date: 07 – 10 September 2026
  • CTET Exam Date: 06 September 2026 Postponed
  • Admit Card Date: Before Exam
  • Exam Result: Will be updated here soon.

Application Fee

  • Paper I: General / OBC ₹1,000; SC / ST / PWD ₹500
  • Both papers: General / OBC ₹1,200; SC / ST / PWD ₹600

Eligibility

Paper I and Paper II eligibility codes are published in the official bulletin. Paper I is for Classes I-V, while Paper II is for Classes VI-VIII. Check the official bulletin for category-wise and NCTE-rule eligibility codes.

For CTET September 2026, interested candidates can apply before 01 September 2026 and use the correction link before the official correction window closes.

Useful official links

  • Online Correction Link
  • Check Correction Notice
  • Apply Online
  • Check Form Re-open Notice
  • CTET Official Website
editorNotes: The supplied CTET information has been consolidated into one record. Verify dates, eligibility codes and any correction / re-open notice against the official CTET portal before publishing an application instruction.
importantInstructions: The official CTET information bulletin and CTET portal control the final eligibility, fee, dates, correction window, admit card, answer key and result information.

faqs.question: Which papers are available in CTET September 2026?
faqs.answer: Paper I is for Classes I to V, Paper II is for Classes VI to VIII, and candidates may apply for Paper I, Paper II or both if they meet the applicable eligibility conditions.

faqs.question: Where can the CTET September 2026 correction notice be checked?
faqs.answer: The correction notice and the form correction link are available on the official CTET portal and through the official correction notice PDF link.

faqs.question: Which fee applies to CTET September 2026?
faqs.answer: The fee depends on the category and whether the candidate selects one paper or both papers. The complete category-wise fee is shown in the Application Fee section.
